plan.name: Keep closing commands in shortened comments
plan.summary: Each factory post supplies its closing instructions separately from its body through post(title, body, marker, closing...), with the entire original separator in closing (both newlines for a blank line, or the space for inline instructions), leaving none of that separator in the body; omitted closing text means no instructions, and no body text is searched for commands. Migrate all instruction-bearing callers and forwarding helpers, including notes and stopped-build guidance, preserving the caller's complete wording, arguments, ratification hash and line breaks for ratify, revise, choose, retry, stop and any other command it asks a person to comment. Reserve space for that exact closing text alongside the unchanged marker, byline and existing omission notice, still dropping collapsed body details before clipping other body text within the existing size budget and keeping valid UTF-8, with the omission notice after the closing text. Posts that already fit, and shortening posts without closing instructions, keep their current output; acceptance retains the large compressed test-source marker, other commands, short posts, diagnostic quotes and wrapped instructions, and checks the full separator on real callers after body clipping and details removal alone, with exact short-post comparisons. Whoever merges records the previously unrecorded two-way decision to preserve explicit caller-supplied closing instructions and their full separator when shortening comments; SPEC.md and README.md remain accurate.

tests.name: TestClippedPlanKeepsRatificationInstructions
tests.says: A proposal whose marker leaves too little room for its acceptance-test table still displays its complete ratify instruction with the correct hash, its revise instruction and their preceding blank line, retains its marker and byline, and reports omitted detail; real plan posts also retain the full blank line when dropping details alone is enough, and short posts stay byte-for-byte unchanged.

tests.name: TestClippedPostsKeepClosingCommands
tests.says: Shortening real posts preserves complete ratify, choose, revise, retry and stop instructions and their original separators, including multiple closing lines and instructions sharing a line with long prose, while retaining valid UTF-8, the marker, the omission notice, details-first reduction and the existing output for posts without commands; real proposals and amendments keep their blank line after dropping details alone, and short callers remain byte-for-byte unchanged.

tests.name: TestPostsKeepOnlyExplicitClosingInstructions
tests.says: Closing instructions supplied separately to post remain whole, including their opening words across line breaks and commands it has never seen; diagnostic quotes of commands in a body with no supplied instructions retain the exact existing short or clipped output, and quoted diagnostics are not promoted when genuine instructions are supplied.
